source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how to add fractions by aligning fractional units and then adding the numerator counts.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Same denominator is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how to add fractions by aligning fractional units and then' is answered as same denominator rather than fraction addition.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Same denominator is what produces fraction addition, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how to add fractions by aligning fractional.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is fraction addition because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Decide how to add fractions by aligning fractional units and then' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: fraction addition is settled by running 'Decide how to reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing both parts': A fraction is in lowest terms when numerator and denominator have no common factor except — on the item about Decide how to add fractions by aligning fractional.

intelligence.enrichment: To add fractions, first express them with the same denominator if needed; then add the numerators over that common denominator and simplify when appropriate.
